limitations: Runtime JSON files and database are separately timestamped snapshots, not one atomic multi-file generation.
Feed health means successful observation, not fresh original content, accurate interpretation, or proven trading value.
This audit uses local retained data and code; it does not verify publishers against the external web.

Per-source latest published clocks are retained publisher metadata, which may include inferred or scheduled dates; publication-window counts explicitly exclude future dates. No freshness conclusion is based only on a successful HTTP fetch.

policy.promotion_requirement: chronological validation before any execution weight

code_findings.finding: Every unranked pair is labeled using global active_scored_pair_count and global active_article_count; articles screened is not an independent per-pair screening count.
news_ranked drops NEUTRAL pair records; news_sentiment returns only top_pairs[:12], hiding neutral context and otherwise limiting pair summaries to 12.
Forward pair score requires timely initial observation, no prior-move report, nonzero published currency differential, and causal age within reaction horizon. Context research scores remain separate.
active_article_count is active clustered topic count after relevance window filtering, not all fetched or classified articles.

enabled_source_errors.reason: Current CPI/CPIF summary missing or malformed

findings.health_definition_caution: Collector healthy/degraded totals count current source error state; source_coverage health additionally applies last-success recency and includes scheduled/external sources. These are different denominators and must not be combined.
findings.zero_direction_interpretation: No current forward factor passed the registered news rules at this snapshot. This does not mean no headlines, no market activity, or no research sentiment.
fix_candidates: Show per-pair active context count and recent headline age; place global scanned/retained totals once in feed status.
Retain neutral/contextual summaries for all pairs rather than returning only 12 non-neutral ranked pairs.
Distinguish contextual sentiment from eligible forward direction and expose the withholding reason.
Repair GDELT throttling, HKMA timeout handling, and SCB parser in a separately reviewed change; preserve corroboration, causal clock and prior-move guards.
Show actual analytical as_of age separately from output generation age.
